jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
CMF – Turning Ideas into Impact.

Wir machen aus „How?" ein „Wow!" mit kreativer Strategie, innovativer Technologie und messbarem Impact. Wir sind eine Full-Service-Agentur und vereinen alle Disziplinen unter einem Dach, ob digital oder analog, klassisch oder crazy, und entwickeln seit über 42 Jahren für namhafte Kunden wie Allianz, Coca-Cola, BMW, Nestlé und Rewe Kampagnen, die begeistern. Verstärke unser rund 100-köpfiges Team am Standort Oberursel als:

Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

Aufgaben
Du sorgst mit klarer Zielgruppenplanung, durchdachten Kampagnen-Setups und sauberem Tracking dafür, dass Kampagnen von Tag eins an funktionieren. Cost-per-Lead, Click-through-Rate, Conversion-Rate sind für dich die Stellschrauben, die du von Beginn an präzise justierst. Bei CMF machst du das für Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn und TikTok und für namhafte Kunden mit echten Ansprüchen, bei denen man spürbar etwas bewegen kann.

Und wenn sich ein Algorithmus ändert, bist du die erste Person im Raum, die weiß, was das für unsere Kampagnen bedeutet.

Qualifikation

Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, mit echtem Budget und echter Verantwortung.

Sicherer Umgang mit Google Ads (Search, Display, Video) und Meta Ads, von der Einrichtung bis zur Auswertung.

Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests und Conversion-Optimierung: Du verbesserst, was schon gut läuft.

SEO-Wissen, technisch wie redaktionell, und ein Blick für GEO. Du weißt, wie Inhalte heute auch in ChatGPT oder Google AI Overviews gefunden werden.

Routine mit Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager und Looker Studio. Attribution und Tracking sind für dich Alltag.

Interesse an KI-Tools und Automatisierung, um Kampagnen effizienter zu steuern und mehr Zeit für die Strategie zu gewinnen.

Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, denn unsere Meetings mit Kunden und im Team laufen auf Deutsch. Gutes Englisch hilft dir bei internationalen Kunden.

Du kennst Trends und Kanäle und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit Text, Kreation überzeugende Journeys und Creatives.

Du berätst Kunden auf Augenhöhe und erklärst Zahlen und Empfehlungen verständlich und triffst gemeinsam mit ihnen fundierte Entscheidungen für ihre Kampagnen.

Benefits
Ein Team mit kurzen Wegen und echter Entscheidungsfreude. Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Zeiten, Projekte, die sich nie wiederholen. Ein modernes, klimafreundliches Büro in Oberursel mit eigener Bar. Attraktive Vergütung, End-of-Year-Bonus, betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit bis zu 50 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, 28 Tage Urlaub und Ausstattung, die mitdenkt: Laptop und Firmenhandy bei Bedarf. Dazu Team-Events, auf die man sich wirklich freut.

Ready to make impact?

Schick uns deine vollständigen Unterlagen, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen möglichen Starttermin, als PDF. Unsere Ansprechpartnerin Bettina Reiner freut sich auf dich.

jobs.title: Scientific Publications Project Manager
jobs.description:
Scientific Publications Project Manager

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Scientific Publications Project Manager
– Publications to join an international healthcare environment and support the coordination and execution of medical publication projects.

This role is ideal for an professional with a scientific background and hands-on experience in inflammatory diseases, immunology, or related medical areas, who enjoys structured project coordination, working with publication platforms, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a global setting.

Job Responsibilities

Provide project management support for medical publication projects within the Inflammation therapeutic area.
Work with the publication platform to support focus markets and assigned projects.
Manage assigned projects on the platform, ensuring accurate real-time updates.
Track timelines, milestones, and deliverables, proactively following up with internal teams, authors, and external agencies.
Act as the primary point of contact for assigned inflammation publication projects.
Consolidate and coordinate author and stakeholder feedback to ensure alignment and follow-through.
Support the organization and execution of medical publication workshops related to inflammatory diseases.
Ensure compliance with publication processes, standards, and timelines.
Support clear, structured communication across multiple stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience working as a Scientific Publications Project Manager or similar roles.

Experience working in agencies or pharmaceutical companies.

Master’s degree in Biological or Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Immunology, or related fields).
Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken).
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Ability to multitask and work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
Service-oriented, structured, and highly detail-focused mindset.
Clear and confident communication skills.

Desirable

Understanding of the medical publications workflow, particularly in inflammation-related indications.
Experience in a scientific communication or medical agency, especially working on inflammation projects.
Exposure to Medical Affairs or cross-functional pharmaceutical teams.
Experience working with digital publication or project management platforms.

What We Offer

Permanent contract through Hays.
Flexible remote working model, with one day per month on-site at the office in Sant Cugat del Vallès (Barcelona area).
Travel expenses fully covered by the company.
Competitive compensation package and flexible working arrangements.
Opportunity to grow within an international and technology‑driven environment.
Collaboration with global stakeholders and cross‑functional teams.

💡 If you are interested in starting your career in project management while working closely with digital systems and international stakeholders, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:

einen Global Client Success Manager (all genders)
in Vollzeit.

Du bist zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für den Kunden auf globaler Ebene
Strategische Anforderungen übersetzt du in klare, umsetzbare Inputs für Momentum

Du arbeitest eng mit Delivery Management an Timelines, Abhängigkeiten und Eskalationen

Governance-Meetings, Account Reviews und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse unterstützt du operativ

Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Kommunikation, Projektmanagement, Medien oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenrolle
Erfahrung im Branchenumfeld Retail & E-Commerce wünschenswert
Gutes Verständnis für Marketing, Content, Produktion und digitale Workflows
Fähigkeit, Business-Anforderungen strukturiert aufzubereiten und in operative Anforderungen zu übersetzen
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeit im Stakeholder-Umfeld, sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch
Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Abstimmungen und internationalen Stakeholder-Strukturen
Fähigkeit, Bedarfe und Muster über Märkte hinweg zu erkennen und strukturiert auszuwerten
Sicheres Gespür für Priorisierung, Demand-Strukturierung und Eskalationssituationen
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Account, Delivery und weiteren cross-funktionalen Teams
Sicherer Umgang mit Briefing- und Intake-Tools sowie Projekt- und Work-Management-Systemen wie Wrike oder vergleichbaren Lösungen
Erfahrung mit Produktions- und DAM-Systemen (z. B. CAPE) sowie Proofing-Tools (z. B. Wrike Proof, Ziflow oder Filestage)
Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Tools wie Figma im Kontext von Templates oder Asset-Abstimmungen
Routine in Reporting- und Dashboard-Tools zur Auswertung von Demand und Performance
Sehr gute Zusammenarbeit in digitalen Umgebungen (z. B. Microsoft Teams und gängigen Kollaborationstools)

Was wir dir bieten:

Onboarding: Durch persönliches Mentoring und digitale Onboarding-Sessions - wir sorgen für deinen perfekten Einstieg
Weiterbildung: Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Ob durch unser internes Campus-Weiterbildungsprogramm zur Erweiterung deiner Fach-, Methoden- oder Persönlichkeitskompetenzen, freiwillige Sprachkurse oder regelmäßige Coachings - wir halten dich up to date
Flexibilität: Durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Mobile Office und Jobsharing-Modelle kannst du deinen Beruf an dein Leben anpassen – und nicht andersrum
Fun: Wer arbeitet, muss auch mal eine Pause machen – bei uns hast du durch regelmäßige After Work und Team Events genug Möglichkeiten (auch virtuell, wenn’s sein muss)
Sport: Großes Sportprogramm sowie Mobilität durch Agenturfahrräder und E-Bikes/E-Bike Leasing
Erreichbarkeit: Unser modernes Office im Kreativviertel Münchens ist dank perfekter Lage gut für dich erreichbar
Internationalität: Als international agierende Agenturgruppe hast du bei uns die Möglichkeit, dich mit Kollegen aus den unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen aus der ganzen Welt zu vernetzen und auszutauschen

jobs.title: Distribution Channel Account Manager (Northern Germany)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we create technologies our customers refer to as their lifeline. Our technology platforms in communications, software, video and services help our customers work safely and more efficiently. Our technology platforms in mission-critical communications, command center software and video security & analytics, bolstered by managed & support services, make cities safer and help communities and businesses thrive. At Motorola Solutions, we are ushering in a new era in public safety and security.

Job Description

As a Distribution Channel Account Manager
you will be responsible for but not limited to the following:

Sales functions which includes: forecasting, project registration, pipeline management through CRM, and proof of concepts for system integrators, demonstration, and market positioning presentations. Business development of distribution spending accounts, identifying new opportunities, and increasing spend though existing partners and identifying new partners. Quarter and annual review meeting with the distribution partners’ management teams. Attendance at trade events as required and working with the distributors at their customer events.
Business to Business functions which includes: sales training for the distributor’s internal sales staff and external sales staff, product management, to best position Motorola Solutions Video Security & Access Control Products enabling them to confidently sell the portfolio of products. Quarterly marketing action plans and implementation, website audits, running incentive schemes and partner program delivery though distribution. Taking ownership of partners' issues to quickly resolve them to ensure best of class service.
General management including stock and inventory management, financial management credit facilities, new part management and end of life, setting annual targets and expectations with MSI management, contract management for new distribution partners as required. Point of sale management and timely receipt for the sales operations team. Also advising on regional requirements ensuring we are working with the appropriate distribution channel partners, based upon the maturity of each brand and the distributors customer base.
Collaboration with colleagues including Channel Sales Managers (Small Medium Business - Corporate Accounts),Inside Sales and Sales Engineering.

Basic Requirements

Qualifications

Strong understanding of the video surveillance & access control market in mid to premium brand space, with an aptitude for selling solutions with a minimum of 5 years experience in this sector.
Self-motivated and focused individual with a passion for technology and an aptitude for customer satisfaction.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English, another language would desirable
Strong negotiation skills. Being comfortable with negotiation at all levels of the business from their partners up to senior management.
Excellent presentation skills verbal and written, able to communicate complex solutions in an informative way, and adapt to a varied audience.
Has a pleasant, friendly style of verbal and written communication.
Excellent knowledge of networking principles and IP communication, CCTV, and access control.
Prior distribution experience is essential for the role, with an understanding of IT and Security distribution, either working in distribution or selling solutions to and through distribution.
Excellent IT skills, in office and other essential programs.

Travel Requirements

25-50%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Company

Motorola Solutions Germany GmbH

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we create technologies our customers refer to as their lifeline. Our technology platforms in communications, software, video and services help our customers work safely and more efficiently. Our technology platforms in mission-critical communications, command center software and video security & analytics, bolstered by managed & support services, make cities safer and help communities and businesses thrive. At Motorola Solutions, we are ushering in a new era in public safety and security.

Job Description

As a Distribution Channel Account Manager
you will be responsible for but not limited to the following:

Sales functions which includes: forecasting, project registration, pipeline management through CRM, and proof of concepts for system integrators, demonstration, and market positioning presentations. Business development of distribution spending accounts, identifying new opportunities, and increasing spend though existing partners and identifying new partners. Quarter and annual review meeting with the distribution partners’ management teams. Attendance at trade events as required and working with the distributors at their customer events.
Business to Business functions which includes: sales training for the distributor’s internal sales staff and external sales staff, product management, to best position Motorola Solutions Video Security & Access Control Products enabling them to confidently sell the portfolio of products. Quarterly marketing action plans and implementation, website audits, running incentive schemes and partner program delivery though distribution. Taking ownership of partners' issues to quickly resolve them to ensure best of class service.
General management including stock and inventory management, financial management credit facilities, new part management and end of life, setting annual targets and expectations with MSI management, contract management for new distribution partners as required. Point of sale management and timely receipt for the sales operations team. Also advising on regional requirements ensuring we are working with the appropriate distribution channel partners, based upon the maturity of each brand and the distributors customer base.
Collaboration with colleagues including Channel Sales Managers (Small Medium Business - Corporate Accounts),Inside Sales and Sales Engineering.

Basic Requirements

Qualifications

Strong understanding of the video surveillance & access control market in mid to premium brand space, with an aptitude for selling solutions with a minimum of 5 years experience in this sector.
Self-motivated and focused individual with a passion for technology and an aptitude for customer satisfaction.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English, another language would desirable
Strong negotiation skills. Being comfortable with negotiation at all levels of the business from their partners up to senior management.
Excellent presentation skills verbal and written, able to communicate complex solutions in an informative way, and adapt to a varied audience.
Has a pleasant, friendly style of verbal and written communication.
Excellent knowledge of networking principles and IP communication, CCTV, and access control.
Prior distribution experience is essential for the role, with an understanding of IT and Security distribution, either working in distribution or selling solutions to and through distribution.
Excellent IT skills, in office and other essential programs.
